# Volume 2 timeline

## II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is interrupted while studying [Virgil](../codex/tech.md#virgil) by her angry new neighbor, Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), who complains about her Jersey cow trespassing in his oats. After a sharp exchange, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) pens up the cow and prepares tea for [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). They discuss farm affairs and are soon joined by Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), who shares local gossip about incoming neighbors and future students.

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) expresses skepticism about the incoming [Irving](../character/irving.md) boy and warns [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) against starting a Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society) in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) remains eager about the initiative, which she and [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) have planned out. Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) also shares that Anne's friend, [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), has been hired to teach at [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody) school.

## III Mr. Harrison at Home

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Shearer](../character/shearer.md), [Dolly](../character/dolly.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Martin](../character/martin.md), [Peter Sloane](../character/peter-sloane.md), French** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) return from a shopping trip in [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody) discussing plans for the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society). Upon seeing a Jersey cow in Mr. Harrison's oat field, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) mistakenly assumes it is her own mischievous cow, chases it out with Diana's help, and impulsively sells it to Mr. [Shearer](../character/shearer.md). After arriving home, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discovers her real cow [Dolly](../character/dolly.md) in the barnyard and realizes she sold Mr. Harrison's cow, prompting her to set off to apologize to him with a nut cake peace offering.

## IV Different Opinions

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes to Mr. Harrison's house to confess that she accidentally sold his Jersey cow to Mr. [Shearer](../character/shearer.md). Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) forgives her, agreeing to take Anne's cow in exchange, and invites her to stay for tea. After making tea and chatting together, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) in high spirits and tells [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) how well everything turned out.

## V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Jane](../character/jane.md), and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) discuss their upcoming teaching roles and debate whether corporal punishment is effective or necessary in maintaining order. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) walks past various local landmarks and visits Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), who also doubts her plan to manage students through affection rather than discipline. The next morning, a nervous [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) shares her fears of failure with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) before starting her first day as a schoolteacher.

## VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women

**[Shirley](../character/shirley.md), [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md), [Annetta Bell](../character/annetta-bell.md), [Barbara Shaw](../character/barbara-shaw.md), Cottons, [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), Morley, [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), Pyes, [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Rogerson](../character/rogerson.md), [Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) begins her first day teaching at the schoolhouse, where she forgets her prepared speech but quietly observes her pupils, bonding instantly with young [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md). After dealing with minor classroom disruptions and a visit from the eccentric Mrs. Donnell regarding her children's names, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives orchids from [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) on her walk home. Later at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) discuss the day's events, including Anthony Pye's stubborn dislike of [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).

## VII The Pointing of Duty

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Catherine Andrews](../character/catherine-andrews.md), [Eliza Andrews](../character/eliza-andrews.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) drive along the [Newbridge](../codex/places.md#newbridge) road to canvass for the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village Improvement Society's hall painting fund. They deal with the dour Miss [Eliza Andrews](../character/eliza-andrews.md) and her optimist sister Catherine, assist a frantic Mr. Blair with baking a cake, and carefully navigate Mrs. Theodore White's spotless home, securing subscriptions along the way.

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md), [Lorenzo White](../character/lorenzo-white.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), [Jane](../character/jane.md), [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md), [Eliza Andrews](../character/eliza-andrews.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) continue canvassing [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) for the [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society), encountering various eccentric neighbors, including a remarkably tidy woman and a father celebrating the birth of his new son. Capitalizing on the newborn boy's arrival, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) convinces [Lorenzo White](../character/lorenzo-white.md) to make a generous donation. Afterwards, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) to ask for a subscription, but he flatly refuses.

## VIII Marilla Adopts Twins

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and the two discuss their teaching experiences, literary ambitions, and future career plans. After [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) leaves, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) returns home and discusses taking in the orphaned Keith twins, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) convinces [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) that taking the children in is their duty, agreeing to handle their sewing despite her dislike for it.

## IX A Question of Color

**Aid Society, [Allan](../character/allan.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Eliza Andrews](../character/eliza-andrews.md), [Lauretta](../character/lauretta.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md), [Wiggins](../character/wiggins.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with the twins, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md) Keith, following their mother's funeral. [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) quickly proves to be a handful, causing a scene at church by dropping a caterpillar down [Lauretta](../character/lauretta.md) White's dress and later tricking [Dora](../character/dora.md) into falling in the pigpen. After being punished for his antics, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) confesses to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that he also hid a toad in Marilla's bed.

**[Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md)** — [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) confesses to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that he put a toad in Marilla's bed as a prank. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) promises not to tell [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) on the condition that [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) refrains from doing it again, and she carefully removes the toad from the bed before [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) notices.

## X Davy in Search of a Sensation

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Joshua Pye](../character/joshua-pye.md), [Roger Pye](../character/roger-pye.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Oliver Sloane](../character/oliver-sloane.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [John Andrew](../character/john-andrew.md), [Peter Sloane](../character/peter-sloane.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) discuss Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) and the village improvement projects, including the plan to paint the local hall green. However, due to a mix-up with the paint numbers, [Joshua Pye](../character/joshua-pye.md) paints the hall a glaring bright blue with a red roof. Although the village is initially shocked by the hideous result, public sympathy shifts in favor of the [Improvers](../codex/factions.md#improvers) against the [Pyes](../codex/factions.md#pyes).

## XI Facts and Fancies

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md), [Barbara Shaw](../character/barbara-shaw.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md), [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) walks home from school feeling content and meets [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) along the [Birch Path](../codex/places.md#birch-path). When she arrives at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) informs her that [Dora](../character/dora.md) is missing, leading to a frantic search around the farm and well. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discovers that [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) locked [Dora](../character/dora.md) in Mr. Harrison's toolhouse and lied about it, but after a heart-to-heart conversation, she helps [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) understand the wrongness of lying before sending him to bed.

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) addresses Davy's misbehavior in his bedroom, explaining why his lying was the dreadful consequence [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) warned him about. Afterwards, she joins [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) downstairs, and they laugh over Davy's antics before discussing how best to raise and discipline him.

## XII A Jonah Day

**[Shirley](../character/shirley.md), [Annetta Bell](../character/annetta-bell.md), [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md), [Aunt Mary](../character/aunt-mary.md), [Barbara Shaw](../character/barbara-shaw.md), [Eliza Andrews](../character/eliza-andrews.md), [God](../character/god.md), [Golden Lady](../character/golden-lady.md), [Jane](../character/jane.md), [Joseph](../character/joseph.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Nora](../character/nora.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md), [Twin Sailors](../character/twin-sailors.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) writes a letter to [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md) sharing humorous anecdotes about her pupils and the compositions they submitted. She details how she confronted [Annetta Bell](../character/annetta-bell.md) for copying old love letters for her assignment and highlights [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) Irving's imaginative letter describing his rock friends.

**[Golden Lady](../character/golden-lady.md), [Nora](../character/nora.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Twin Sailors](../character/twin-sailors.md)** — [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) writes to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about his imaginative friends at the shore, including [Nora](../character/nora.md), the [Twin Sailors](../character/twin-sailors.md), and the [Golden Lady](../character/golden-lady.md). He describes fantastical adventures, such as sailing into a moonglade and visiting the sunset, before clarifying in a postscript that the letter is not real.

## XIII A Golden Picnic

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md), [Barbara Shaw](../character/barbara-shaw.md), [Clair Donnell](../character/clair-donnell.md), [Joe Sloane](../character/joe-sloane.md), [Rogerson](../character/rogerson.md), [Annetta Bell](../character/annetta-bell.md), [Chester Sloane](../character/chester-sloane.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Jane](../character/jane.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md)** — In a terrible mood caused by a toothache, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has a disaster-filled day at school, accidentally exploding a package of firecrackers brought by a student before whipping [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md) for putting a mouse in her desk. After venting her shame and regret to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) at home, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is surprised the next morning when Anthony treats her with new respect. Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) later confirms that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has finally won Anthony over by giving him a proper whipping.

## XIV A Danger Averted

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Jane](../character/jane.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) invites [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Jane](../character/jane.md), and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) on a springtime walk to celebrate her unofficial birthday. As they explore the woods and name a hidden pool, they discover the forgotten garden of [Hester Gray](../character/hester-gray.md), where [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) shares the tragic love story behind it.

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Jane](../character/jane.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Jane](../character/jane.md), and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) talk about Hester Gray's life and story while resting in her garden. They spend the afternoon exploring the surrounding woods and sharing lunch by a brook, engaging in poetic conversations about nature and souls before walking home at sunset.

## XV The Beginning of Vacation

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Chester Sloane](../character/chester-sloane.md), [Jane](../character/jane.md), [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md), [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md), [Carrie Sloane](../character/carrie-sloane.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Julia Bell](../character/julia-bell.md), [Oliver Sloane](../character/oliver-sloane.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) walks home with Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), discussing community news and preparations for an upcoming bazaar. At home, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) receives a letter from the twins' uncle postponing his taking them, after which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) remembers a past conversation with [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) following his jam-stealing episode. Later, at an [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society) meeting, the members are outraged to learn that [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) plans to rent his fence for advertisements, and a committee sent to reason with him returns unsuccessful.

**[Oliver Sloane](../character/oliver-sloane.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), Improvers, [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md), [Allan](../character/allan.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Louisa Spencer](../character/louisa-spencer.md), [Levi Boulter](../character/levi-boulter.md), [Lorenzo White](../character/lorenzo-white.md), [Jerry Corcoran](../character/jerry-corcoran.md), [Spencer](../character/spencer.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and [Jane](../character/jane.md) visit [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) to convince him not to rent his fences for advertising, but he refuses their request. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally overhears Judson taking a political bribe from [Jerry Corcoran](../character/jerry-corcoran.md) near the Lake of [Shining Waters](../codex/places.md#shining-waters). Fearing [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) will expose the bribe, Judson quickly agrees to pull his advertising agreement, allowing [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to announce to the [Improvers](../codex/factions.md#improvers) that the fences are saved.

## XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Allan](../character/allan.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) completes her school year and walks to the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) cemetery to tend Matthew's grave. Along the way, she talks with [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) about his mother, imagination, and school life. At the graveyard, after placing flowers on Matthew's and Hester Gray's graves, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) meets Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md) and they walk home together discussing teaching, future goals, and friendship.

## XVII A Chapter of Accidents

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [John Henry Carter](../character/john-henry-carter.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives exciting news in a letter that the famous author Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) will be visiting [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) and coming to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for dinner. After clearing up one of Davy's funny misconceptions about heaven, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) enthusiastically plans an elaborate meal and prepares the house for the honored guest. She also visits [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to share the news and coordinate their preparations for the big event.

## XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Allan](../character/allan.md), [Stacy](../character/stacy.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) enthusiastically decorate [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and prepare a elaborate dinner for the arrival of author Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md). However, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) accidentally destroys the lemon pies, Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) fails to arrive, and the green peas are ruined by too much sugar. To top off the series of misfortunes, Miss Barry's valuable platter is accidentally smashed, but [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) later receives a letter explaining that Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) could not attend due to a sprained ankle.

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — After cleaning up and seeing [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) off, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives a letter from [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) stating that Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) will not be able to visit [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) due to a sprained ankle. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discuss the day's disappointments, how to replace Miss Barry's broken platter, and neighborhood gossip about Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) before [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) arrives.

## XIX Just a Happy Day

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Sarah](../character/sarah.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) puts [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) to bed and chats with him before [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) signals her to come over with news of a potential replacement willow-ware platter at the Copp place. The next day, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) drive to [Spencervale](../codex/places.md#spencervale) to search for the platter, but upon finding the Copp home empty, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) climbs onto a small duck house to peek into the pantry window. She crashes through the roof and gets trapped, having to wait through a rainstorm until Miss [Sarah](../character/sarah.md) Copp returns and releases her with an axe, after which Miss [Sarah](../character/sarah.md) offers to sell her the platter over tea.

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Sarah](../character/sarah.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) apologizes to Miss [Sarah](../character/sarah.md) Copp for looking through her window while trying to purchase the blue willow-ware platter. Miss [Sarah](../character/sarah.md) hosts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) for tea, complaining about her sister Martha, and agrees to sell the platter to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for twenty-five dollars to help fund her upcoming marriage. Afterward, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) drive home down the [Tory Road](../codex/places.md#tory-road), laughing over the day's events as [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) holds her new treasure.

## XX The Way It Often Happens

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Mary Joe](../character/mary-joe.md), [Grandma Irving](../character/grandma-irving.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) spends a pleasant late-August day rowing with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and the twins before visiting [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) at his grandmother's house. Over tea and in his room, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) shares his imaginative thoughts and worries, which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reassures him about. Returning home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) puts a jealous [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) to bed and later meets [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) by the Dryad's [Bubble](../codex/places.md#dryad-s-bubble).

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — After putting [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) to bed, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) meets [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) down by the Dryad's [Bubble](../codex/places.md#dryad-s-bubble) to discuss their improvement society's progress and upcoming plans for the community. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to the house and talks with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) about her busy schedule for the following day.

## XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md), [Morgan](../character/morgan.md), [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) leaves for town while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stays home and handles chores, including transferring feathers between ticks, which leaves her covered in fluff. Mistaking a bottle of dye for her freckle lotion, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally colors her nose bright red right before [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) unexpectedly arrives with famous author Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) and Mrs. [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md). After quickly washing off the dye, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) host the distinguished guests for a pleasant meal and a stroll through the local sights before they depart.

## XXII Odds and Ends

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Milty Boulter](../character/milty-boulter.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Mirabel Cotton](../character/mirabel-cotton.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to teaching, dealing with schoolroom antics from [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and comforting [Dora](../character/dora.md) after [Mirabel Cotton](../character/mirabel-cotton.md) frightens her with ghost stories. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) set out to walk to a tea party in [West Grafton](../codex/places.md#east-grafton), but accidentally wander down an enchanted wood lane that leads them to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), the home of Miss [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md). Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) warmly invites the lost girls inside to join her for a tea party she had been playfully imagining by herself.

**[Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md), [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) enjoy a merry tea party and explore the charming surroundings of [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) with Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and Charlotta the Fourth. Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) demonstrates the garden's enchanting echoes and explains how her young maid came by her numerical moniker. Before the girls depart, a slip of the tongue brings up [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) Irving's name, leaving Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) visibly moved and quiet as she gives them lavendar and bids them farewell.

## XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — At the breakfast table, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discuss Miss [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), and [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md) Lynde's ill health while reprimanding [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) for his poor table manners. Later, news arrives that [Richard Keith](../character/richard-keith.md) has passed away and left money in trust for [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md), ensuring the twins can stay at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) permanently.

## XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Irving](../character/irving.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) during a winter storm, where Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) reveals the backstory of her failed engagement to [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md). A month later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) introduces Stephen's son, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md), to Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), and the two immediately form a affectionate bond.

## XXV An Avonlea Scandal

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Uncle Abe](../character/uncle-abe.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Annetta Bell](../character/annetta-bell.md), [Harmon Andrews](../character/harmon-andrews.md), [John Henry Carter](../character/john-henry-carter.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Ginger](../character/ginger.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) joke about their anonymous newspaper prank and Uncle Abe's storm prediction, but an extraordinarily severe hail and thunder storm strikes [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) on that exact date. The storm destroys crops, damages homes, kills Mr. Harrison's parrot [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), and wrecks the trees planted by the [Improvers](../codex/factions.md#improvers). Afterwards, the community recovers and assesses the widespread damage, while [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) resolve to replant their lost trees next spring.

## XXVI Around the Bend

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Emily](../character/emily.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discovers that Mr. Harrison's wife, [Emily](../character/emily.md), has arrived at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) looking for him, shocking the neighborhood. Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) investigates the situation while [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) brings home local gossip about the couple's past separation. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), who reveals his newly scrubbed home and prepares to explain why he and his wife had parted ways.

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Emily](../character/emily.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md)** — Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) explains to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) how he and his wife [Emily](../character/emily.md) separated over his parrot [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), and how they have now reconciled. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) gets acquainted with Mrs. Harrison, who walks her back across the fields, before [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to find [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) chatting with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).

## XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House

**[Shirley](../character/shirley.md), [Annetta Bell](../character/annetta-bell.md), [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md), [Barbara Shaw](../character/barbara-shaw.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Grandma Irving](../character/grandma-irving.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Milty Boulter](../character/milty-boulter.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md)** — Following [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md) Lynde's death, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) invites the widowed Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) to live at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), enabling [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to leave her teaching post and attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). News of Anne's resignation causes sorrow among her pupils and friends, though [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) is delighted. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) discuss their upcoming separations, local gossip, and hopes for the future.

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), [Jane](../character/jane.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) worries about [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) leaving for [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) and asks if she has romantic feelings for [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) denies. They talk about [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md) and [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) before reaffirming their deep, lifelong friendship with each other.

## XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace

**[Shirley](../character/shirley.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Eliza Andrews](../character/eliza-andrews.md), [Gracie](../character/gracie.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Rogerson](../character/rogerson.md)** — During lunch, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) recounts [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) Irving's misadventure at the brook, prompting [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to leave the table in amusement. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) walk to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) to visit Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and Charlotta the Fourth. After enjoying food, echoes, and conversation, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) head out into a nearby pasture to pick early strawberries.

**[Shirley](../character/shirley.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md)** — [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) expresses concern to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) over Miss Lavendar's listlessness and lack of spirit, prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to promise a week-long visit during her vacation to help cheer her up. After enjoying tea in the garden, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) talks with Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) about her imaginary dream-boy, forming a sweet bond of understanding with her before [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) head home.

## XXIX Poetry and Prose

**[Shirley](../character/shirley.md), [Harmon Andrews](../character/harmon-andrews.md), [Peter Sloane](../character/peter-sloane.md), [William Bell](../character/william-bell.md), [Jane](../character/jane.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Allan](../character/allan.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Gracie](../character/gracie.md), [Mary Joe](../character/mary-joe.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), [Grandma Irving](../character/grandma-irving.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finishes her teaching term, leaving local mothers to gossip about her future and [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md). She later visits [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) and then Paul's home, where she meets Paul's father, [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), who asks her to pass a message to Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) joyfully acts as a matchmaker, delivering Stephen's request and helping Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) prepare for his arrival.

**[Shirley](../character/shirley.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) help Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) prepare for Stephen Irving's arrival. When Stephen arrives, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) greets him and ushers him into the parlor with Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) wait anxiously in the kitchen cleaning silver until they spot Stephen and Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) walking happily together in the garden, confirming their romantic reunion.

## XXX A Wedding at the Stone House

**[Shirley](../character/shirley.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Grandma Irving](../character/grandma-irving.md), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) is buzzing with preparations for Miss Lavendar's upcoming wedding, with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and Charlotta the Fourth helping out. [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) share their perspectives on the romance, highlighting the difference between seeing life through poetry versus prose. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) later discovers that [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md) are secretly engaged, leading to a heartfelt conversation between the two friends about love and their futures.

## Chapter 32

**[Allan](../character/allan.md), [Shirley](../character/shirley.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Eliza Andrews](../character/eliza-andrews.md), [Emily](../character/emily.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Irving](../character/irving.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), [Uncle Abe](../character/uncle-abe.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) help Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and Charlotta the Fourth prepare [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) for the upcoming wedding. The next day, Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) are married in the garden surrounded by friends, after which the wedding party sees them off at [Bright River](../codex/places.md#bright-river) station. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to clean up the stone house with [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) and later walks home with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), experiencing a quiet moment of romantic awakening.
